faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is Vocab Mate free to use?
faq.a1: Yes! You can register a free account and start reading articles, looking up AI terms, and saving useful words immediately.
faq.q2: How does the AI Agent assist my learning?
faq.a2: The AI Agent analyzes sentence context, provides natural translations, and offers usage examples for prepared vocabulary terms.
faq.q3: Can I change my target CEFR level later?
faq.a3: Absolutely! You can update your target CEFR level (A1 to C2) at any time in your Profile Settings.
faq.q4: Where do the news articles come from?
faq.a4: Articles are ingested directly from reputable international news sources such as The Guardian, ensuring rich and authentic language.
